title: MuPACE: Learning to Pace Muon for LoRA Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration. Practitioners re-tune a schedule for every new problem, yet a tuned schedule still cannot react to the training dynamics it encounters. We instead amortize learning rate selection across LoRA fine-tuning problems. We leave the base optimizer, Muon, untouched, so that its normalized update fixes the direction, and meta-learn only the global step size. Our method MuPACE is a small recurrent policy, meta-trained across a distribution of fine-tuning runs, that conditions on the observed trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an interpretable analytic schedule. On 64 fine-tuning problems, MuPACE outperforms standard fixed schedules at a strong shared default on 64-78% of problems and is on par with the same

translated_title: MuPACE：学习为LoRA微调调控Muon优化器的步调节奏
translated_abstract: 学习率调度通常在训练开始前就已固定，然而在使用低秩适配器（LoRA）微调大型语言模型时，合适的尺度会随模型、任务和适配器配置的不同而产生显著变化。从业者需要为每个新问题重新调整调度，但即便经过调整的调度仍然无法对其遇到的训练动态做出反应。我们转而在多个LoRA微调问题上摊销学习率的选择。我们保持基础优化器Muon完全不变，使其归一化更新固定更新方向，仅对全局步长进行元学习。我们的方法MuPACE是一个小型循环策略，通过在一系列微调运行的分布上进行元训练，它以观测到的训练轨迹为条件，对可解释的解析调度输出有界的调整。在64个微调问题上，MuPACE在64-78%的问题上优于采用统一强大默认设置的标准固定调度，并与相同的……持平。
tldr: MuPACE通过在大量微调任务上元训练一个轻量循环策略，自适应地为Muon优化器调控LoRA微调的全局学习率步长，在无需逐任务调参的情况下于大多数问题上超越固定学习率调度。
en_tdlr: MuPACE meta-learns a small recurrent policy that adaptively paces the global step size of the Muon optimizer during LoRA fine-tuning, outperforming fixed learning-rate schedules on the majority of problems without per-task tuning.
